judge.rationale: The candidate implementation is incomplete and stops mid-way, never actually implementing message handling in `messageHandler.ts` or wiring `createServer.ts`, which means its own acceptance tests in `conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` fail. Furthermore, it invents completely wrong message types and names (`list_sessions` / `session_list` / `ListSessionsMessage` instead of `list_conversations` / `conversation_list` / `ListConversationsMessage` explicitly specified in the ticket). It also directly contradicts core requirements from the ticket: it allows `limit: 0` and unbounded limits instead of restricting to 1–200, plans to return an empty list when `listFor` is missing instead of `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, and completely omits the `transport.history` opt-in configuration, `StoreCannotList`, changelog, and documentation updates.
